questionEn: What is characteristic specifically of “chemical reaction”, and not of a related concept?
questionUz: Tegishli tushunchaga emas, balki "kimyoviy reaksiya" ga nima xosdir?
choicesEn: is a process in which a substance is changed into one or more new substances
determines the chemical properties of a substance
The ability of an atom to form a certain number of chemical bonds
Electrically neutral particle consisting of a nucleus and electrons
choicesUz: moddaning bir yoki bir nechta yangi moddalarga aylanishi jarayonidir
Atomning ma'lum miqdordagi kimyoviy bog'lanishlar hosil qilish qobiliyati
Yadro va elektronlardan tashkil topgan elektr neytral zarracha
explanationEn: A chemical reaction is a process in which a substance is changed into one or more new substances.
explanationUz: Kimyoviy reaksiya - bu moddaning bir yoki bir nechta yangi moddalarga aylanishi jarayoni.
